  1. Home
  2. How we work

From first call to production, with no surprises.

You work directly with the engineer who designs and builds your software, in short cycles you can see and steer.

01 — Discover

Scope & strategy

It starts with a short call about what you’re building, who it’s for and what constrains it: budget, deadlines and the systems already in place.

What you get: An agreed scope: requirements, assumptions, risks and what success looks like.

02 — Design

Architecture & plan

Before production code is written, we agree the architecture, the data model and the main user flows, and choose tools your team will be comfortable living with.

What you get: An architecture you can explain, and a plan in small, shippable steps.

03 — Build

Iterative delivery

Work ships in short cycles with regular demos, so you can steer early. Every change comes with automated tests: unit, integration and end-to-end.

What you get: Working software from early on, and a test suite that keeps it working.

04 — Deploy

Launch & support

We take care of the production deployment and monitoring, and stay on after launch, when real users find the edge cases.

What you get: A running system, the knowledge to operate it, and support after launch.

Principles

What you can expect.

Built to grow without a rewrite

Simple, containerised foundations that scale when you need them to, instead of a rebuild in year two.

Tested end to end

Unit, integration and end-to-end tests are part of the work, not an optional extra.

Direct access

You talk to the engineer designing and building your software, not a chain of account managers.

Honest scoping

If something will take longer, cost more or isn’t worth building, you’ll hear it early.

Works with your team

We fit into existing codebases and work alongside your frontend, QA and infrastructure people.

Your data stays yours

No selling it, no advertising use and no training models on it. Our privacy policy has the details.

Questions

Common questions.

Can you work on an existing codebase?

Yes. We can start from your existing code, even with little handover, and improve it in place rather than rewriting it.

Who owns the code?

That’s set out in the written agreement for your project, which we agree before work starts.

How do you handle our data?

Only as your agreement and instructions allow. We don’t sell it, use it for advertising or train models on it, and we delete it on request or within 30 days of the agreement ending. See our privacy policy.

How do we start?

Leave your email on the contact page or write to [email protected]. We’ll reply by email to set up a short call.

Ready to talk it through?

Tell us what you’re building. We’ll reply by email to set up a short call.
